## Task

Using `inputs/raw/infant_mortality_countries.csv` (see `inputs/raw/codebooks/infant_mortality_countries.md`), make one figure for a short report that shows how infant mortality (`infant_mortality_per_1000`) relates to income per capita (`income_usd_per_capita`) across countries, and write two sentences describing it.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

countries <- read_csv(here::here("inputs/raw/infant_mortality_countries.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```
